description: pkix-composite/src/lib.rs:73-83 — CompositeVerifier implements SignatureVerifier but the verify_signature body is a stub that unconditionally returns Err(SignatureError::new()). The doc says 'Not yet implemented'. A caller who plugs CompositeVerifier into pkix_chain::verify_chain will get silent verification failures with no indication that this is stub behavior. Fix: mark the impl or the struct with a deprecation notice, or at minimum add a compile_error!/assert in debug builds. The cleanest approach matching pkix-ct: mark CompositeVerifier with #[deprecated = "pkix-composite is not yet implemented; all signature verifications will fail"].
title: [rusty/pkix-composite] CompositeVerifier::verify_signature stub not marked #[deprecated]
